backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining data types, storage maps, mixins, and state for users, submissions, timers, market intelligence, API keys, polls, and content stores.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module containing OldActor and NewActor type definitions for data upgrade compatibility between canister versions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.

frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining design tokens, themes, and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template loading the React application root and main script.
frontend/NO_VISUAL_CHANGES_ALERTS_BACKEN: Documentation outlining backend alerts system additions and related React Query hooks with no frontend visual changes.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the main app layout, query client, and all routes for the site using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/AdminApiKeysPane: Provides an admin UI to view and update API key configurations for external data providers.

frontend/src/hooks/useCryptoNews.ts: Fetches and formats crypto news from CryptoPanic with periodic refetching.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context and provider, handling login, identity loading, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useLivePrice.ts: Fetches live crypto and metals prices from external APIs and updates them periodically.

frontend/src/hooks/useParallax.ts: Implements scroll- and pointer-based parallax motion effects with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, market intel access, presale/airdrop timers, and alerts using an actor backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useRealWorldAnalytics: Provides hooks for fetching and refreshing mock global crypto analytics snapshots plus helpers for formatting market cap.

frontend/src/hooks/useTokenAdvancedAnaly: Fetches token data from CoinGecko to compute volatility, trend, market strength, and volume-based analytics.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers, CSS variables, and animated background effects for the app’s base styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.

frontend/src/pages/IndicatorsGuidePage.t: Shows an indicators guide page with explanations of technical indicators using cards and accordion sections.

frontend/src/pages/MarketIntelPage.tsx: Provides access-controlled market intelligence with asset/timeframe selection, refresh actions, and lock/unlock flows.
frontend/src/pages/MarketPulsePage.tsx: Shows real-time market momentum and technical indicators with refresh, loading, and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Renders a styled 404 page with navigation actions and links to other site sections.
frontend/src/pages/PartnersPage.tsx: Displays a branded partners page with placeholder content indicating upcoming ecosystem information.
